The '''battle between the Kumauri Empire and the Republic''' was a confrontation<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" /> that constituted a part of the [[Galactic Republic–Kumauri Empire war|war]] fought between the [[Kumauri Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. That conflict was fought<ref name="EGTW" /> after the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Vall Kumauri]] conquered several dozen [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> around [[10,000 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The battle, which saw the participation of [[Vall Kumauri's flagship|Kumauri's flagship]], was eventually depicted in a fresco located in a [[Kumauri palace|Kumauri Empire palace]] on an [[Unidentified Outer Rim moon|Outer Rim Territories moon]].<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" /> Kumauri's empire was ultimately defeated by the Republic and imploded within a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of its own creation.<ref name="CRO" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
The battle between the Kumauri Empire and the Republic had been long forgotten<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643 BBY">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Palace of the Kumauri" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> when the palace on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was discovered. An individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] eventually sent a companion to explore the structure, and the latter discovered the fresco depicting the battle.<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The battle between the Kumauri Empire and the Republic was mentioned in an Archaeology Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" />
